message.content: the agent hangs when a test starts a dev server. add a timeout to the bash tool

content.text: Added a 60-second timeout to the bash tool. On timeout it kills the whole process group, so servers started by tests die too, and it returns the partial output with a note. All tests pass.

message.content: when the sandbox blocks something, the model just retries the same command. can it get a hint?

content.text: The bash tool now spots sandbox denials and adds a hint: the command was blocked by the sandbox, network is off, and writes only work inside the project folder. In a test run the model switched to a local fixture instead of retrying. One gap: the hint fires on any 'operation not permitted', so a real permission error gets the same message.

message.content: ok, leave that edge case for tomorrow. write the README section

content.text: Added a Sandbox section to the README: what is blocked, how to turn it off with SANDBOX=off, and what the hint looks like. Tomorrow: tell sandbox denials apart from real permission errors by checking the sandbox log.
